constraints.primaryEvidence: upstream issue plus local host conformance failure
constraints.strategy: retain the last proven version and re-run host conformance before removing the block
constraints.versionGate: apply only when the installed version exactly matches an affected entry
constraints.expiryPolicy: retest within 14 days; do not silently extend stale evidence
constraints.sunsetWhen: an upstream release closes the issue and passes agentic-kit's host-neutral hook and lifecycle conformance suite

constraints.expiryPolicy: retest within 14 days; do not silently extend stale evidence
